name.text: Solve for the unknown in a probability distribution function for a continuous random variable

questiontext.text:
The graph of the probability density function \(f(x)\), given by

\[ f(x)= \begin{cases} {@f_disp_1@} & 0 \leq x < {@aa-1@} \\ {@f_disp_2@} & {@aa-1@} \leq x \leq {@aa@} \\ 0 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \]

where \(k\) is a constant and \(x\) is continuous random variable, is shown below.

[[jsxgraph]] var a = {#aa#}; var k = {#kk#}; var y_max = 0; var i = 0; for (i = 0; i < a - 1;) { if (k * (i ** 2 - a * i + 2 * a) >= y_max) { y_max = k * (i ** 2 - a * i + 2 * a) }; i = i + 0.1; } var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { boundingbox: [-0.5, y_max * 1.1, a + 1, - 0.2], showCopyright: false, axis: true, showNavigation: false }); var f_1 = board.create('functiongraph', [function (x) { return k * (x ** 2 - a * x + 2 * a); }, 0, a - 1] ); var f_2 = board.create('functiongraph', [function (x) { return k * (a + 1); }, a - 1, a] ); [[/jsxgraph]]

Find the value of \(k\). Give your answer as a fraction in its lowest terms.

\(k=\) [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]]

prtcorrect.text: Correct answer, well done.

prtpartiallycorrect.text: Your answer is partially correct.

prtincorrect.text: Incorrect answer.

truefeedback.text:
For a continuous random variable \(x\) with probability density function \(f(x)\) where \(a\leq x \leq b\), \(\displaystyle \int_{a}^{b} f(x) = 1\). So, in this case,

\[\displaystyle \int_{0}^{{@aa-1@}} {@f_disp_1@} \cdot dx + \int_{{@aa-1@}}^{{@aa@}} {@f_disp_2@} \cdot dx = 1\]

\[\displaystyle \int_{0}^{{@aa-1@}} kx^2 - {@aa@}k x+{@2*aa@}k \cdot dx + \int_{{@aa-1@}}^{{@aa@}} {@f_disp_2@} \cdot dx = 1\]

\[\displaystyle \left[ {@1/3@} kx^3 - {@aa/2@}k x^2+{@2*aa@}kx \right]_{0}^{{@aa-1@}} + \left[ {@k*(aa+1)@}x \right]_{{@aa-1@}}^{{@aa@}} = 1\]

\[\displaystyle \left( {@1/3@} k\cdot {@aa-1@}^3 - {@aa/2@}k \cdot {@aa-1@}^2+{@2*aa@}k \cdot {@aa-1@} \right) - \left( {@1/3@} k\cdot 0^3 - {@aa/2@}k \cdot 0^2+{@2*aa@}k \cdot 0 \right) + {@k*(aa+1)@} \cdot {@aa@} - {@k*(aa+1)@} \cdot {@aa-1@} = 1 \]

\[\displaystyle {@(aa-1)^3/3@} k - {@aa*(aa-1)^2/2@}k +{@2*aa*(aa-1)@}k + {@k*(aa+1)*aa@} - {@k*(aa+1)*(aa-1)@} = 1 \]

\[\displaystyle {@(aa-1)^3/3 - aa*(aa-1)^2/2 + 2*aa*(aa-1) + (aa+1)*aa - (aa+1)*(aa-1)@} k = 1 \]

\[\displaystyle k = {@ta_1@} \]
